name: WAT.ai
description: The University of Waterloo's Artificial Intelligence design team, working on applied machine learning projects, research collaborations, and workshops.

cycles.notes: Core Member applications are open September 9 to 18, with rolling interviews happening during the window and the form closing September 18 at 11:59 PM EST. You can apply to up to 3 projects. Core Member is an unpaid volunteer role, about 3-5 hours a week, running Fall 2026 through Winter 2027.
